# Asset and dependency notices

The material plates were generated for this integration kit using the user's supplied reference. The reference is included as user-provided design material. Do not represent the generated scene as a photograph of a physical product or as an all-vector drawing.

Sound edits derive from CC0-1.0 recordings. Preserve `audio/SOURCES.md` and `audio/recordings.json` when redistributing the kit. The source creators and exact recording pages are listed there, even though CC0 does not require attribution. Source previews are retained for traceability. The original app's three recordings and their existing provenance are not included or replaced.

Instrument Sans, Space Grotesk and IBM Plex Mono are distributed with their original font licence files in `artwork/fonts`. Runtime files came from the corresponding Fontsource packages; keep the supplied licences when self-hosting.

The prebuilt preview bundles React and React DOM 18.3.1, under the MIT licence. Their original notices are in `references/react-LICENSE.txt` and `references/react-dom-LICENSE.txt`. The production source imports React from the host application. Other development dependencies are recorded in package.json and package-lock.json and are not browser runtime dependencies of the supplied source component.
